title: A Quiet Sunday
text: On Sunday, we stay at home. My father does the gardening and my mother cooks. I watch a programme on TV and then I read a comic. My sister listens to music with her headphones. In the afternoon, we have friends round. We drink tea, talk and play a game. In the evening, everybody relaxes.

title: The Music Class
text: Our music teacher is Mr Karimov. He plays the piano very well. In his class, we learn to play musical instruments. Bobur plays the guitar and Nodira plays the violin. I play the drums, and I am very loud! Next month there is a school concert. We are in a band and we play pop music. Mr Karimov says, "I am proud of you."

title: Students from Many Countries
text: In my English class, there are students from many countries. Anna is from Germany, so she is German. Marco is from Italy, so he is Italian. Yuki is from Japan, and she is Japanese. Li is Chinese. Raj is from India, so he is Indian. We all speak English in the class, and we talk about our countries and continents.

title: A Day in the Countryside
text: We go to the countryside for a picnic. We walk on a path through the forest and climb a small hill. At the top there is a beautiful lake. We see a farmer in a field near the village. There is a river behind the hill, and some wild birds are on the water. We eat our picnic next to a big tree. It is a lovely day in nature.
